description: This file defines TypeScript types and interfaces related to wizard prompts, including options, parameters, progress updates, and a class for cancellation errors. It models a framework for creating interactive command-line or application prompts.

classes.name: WizardCancelledError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating a wizard operation was cancelled.

methods.name: intro
methods.description: Initializes the prompt with a title, returning a promise that resolves when complete.

methods.name: outro
methods.description: Finalizes the prompt with a message, returning a promise that resolves when complete.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Displays a note message, optionally with a title, returning a promise when done.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Displays a selection prompt with options, returning a promise that resolves to the selected value.

methods.name: multiselect
methods.description: Displays a multi-selection prompt, returning a promise that resolves to an array of selected values.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Displays a text input prompt, returning a promise that resolves to the entered string.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation prompt, returning a promise that resolves to a boolean.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Creates a progress indicator, providing methods to update or stop the progress.
